name: The Heart of Racing
note: US team (Seattle) that runs Aston Martin's works WEC Hypercar and IMSA GTP programmes under the name Aston Martin THOR Team; THOR stands for The Heart of Racing. The team is backed by Gabe Newell (claim heart-of-racing-newell-backing); the source says 'backing', not a stated shareholding, so ownership is null and the ownerVerb is 'paid for by'.
